query: Add credits to our AI writing app. Users buy packs of credits and every generation should cost some, depending on how many tokens it used.
Each API call to our image endpoint should use up credits from the customer's prepaid balance, and they should get a 402 when they run out.
People open ten tabs and start ten generations with one credit left, and all ten run. How do I stop that?
When a transcription job crashes halfway the user's credits are gone anyway. Make failed jobs give the credits back, and make sure a retry is not charged twice.
Our Pro plan should include 2,000 credits a month that reset at renewal, on top of the credit packs people can buy.
We sell AI credits for our chatbot. Charge each request by the input and output tokens OpenAI and Anthropic report, including cached tokens and reasoning tokens.
When users press stop during a streamed Gemini answer we charge nothing. Charge them for what was generated, and do not charge twice when the client retries.
Give each agent task in our app a hard credit cap so one runaway run cannot drain an account.
Verify the signature on the payment provider's webhook before we mark the order as paid.
Let users cash out their earned balance to PayPal with a minimum of 10 dollars.
Rate limit our public API to 100 requests per minute per API key.
Add streaming responses from the OpenAI API to our chat interface.
Set up tracing and latency dashboards for our LLM calls.
